sections.text:
The **best affordable options** for small businesses that specifically track visibility in **ChatGPT** and **AI Overviews** are **Otterly**, **Siftly**, and **CheckThat.ai** for budget monitoring, with **SE Ranking** as the best all-in-one SEO suite if you also want traditional SEO features in the same subscription.[1][6][8]

- **Otterly** — Best low-cost choice for AI visibility tracking; public entry pricing is **$29/month**, and it covers **Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Copilot**.[1][6]
- **Siftly** — Good budget-friendly option for small teams that want monitoring plus guidance on what to fix; it is positioned as an affordable AI SEO tool for small businesses and starts with plans around **$79/month**.[1][6]
- **CheckThat.ai** — Strong option if you mainly want **chatbot visibility tracking**; it offers **free access** with payment only for custom prompt tracking and monitors **ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, and Google AI Mode**.[8]
- **SE Ranking** — Best value if you want **SEO + AI visibility** together; its Core plan starts at **$103.20/month annually** and includes AI search visibility monitoring alongside broader SEO tools.[1][5]
- **Rankscale.ai** — A lower-cost specialized tracker mentioned by reviewers, starting at about **$20/month**, useful if your priority is granular AI search visibility analysis rather than a full SEO suite.[11]

For a small business on a tight budget, the most practical short list is:

| Need | Best fit | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Lowest-cost AI visibility tracking | **Otterly** | Cheapest clearly listed paid option with ChatGPT and AI Overviews coverage.[1][6] |
| Free or near-free entry | **CheckThat.ai** | Free access for baseline monitoring.[8] |
| Tracking plus actionable guidance | **Siftly** | Designed for small businesses that need monitoring and fixes, not just reports.[6] |
| Full SEO stack with AI visibility | **SE Ranking** | Combines conventional SEO workflow with AI visibility tracking.[1][5] |

If you want, I can also turn this into a **ranked shortlist by budget**—for example, **under $30/month**, **under $100/month**, or **best for local businesses**.
